spec_metadata.paradigm: declarative contract check (Observation-only, aligned with L2.2 Validation Capability)
spec_metadata.validation_output_nature: PASS/FAIL observation — NOT an approval action, NOT a registration trigger
spec_metadata.registration_authority: Human-only (validation PASS is a necessary condition, NOT sufficient authorization)

dimensions.label: Structural validation
checks: all required five-layer fields present (Identity / Strategy / Definition / Evidence / Evolution)
Definition layer contains all six fields (positive_boundary / negative_boundary / activation_rule / conflict_resolution / exclusion_rules / validation_criteria)

dimensions.label: Semantic validation
checks: positive_boundary and negative_boundary are mutually consistent

dimensions.label: Authority leakage validation
checks: contract contains NO decision / selection / routing / execution / governance / metrics field
NO priority / score / confidence / ranking / recommendation numeric fields

dimensions.label: Evidence validation
checks: evidence references are traceable (empty list is legal at PROPOSED status)
status is a legal initial value (PROPOSED)
maturity is auto-computed (LOW at registration time)
